text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a new year. Shinko Windy has<n>finished her
senior year and is<n>attending a ceremony to receive
the<n>award she's been after!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh nice, the ceremony broadcast is<n>live. What are
they saying for the dirt<n>category? Oh! I knew it!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
The Best Dirt Umamusume award<n>goes to Shinko
Windy!<n>Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
You may still remember Shinko Windy<n>as the
notorious "biter" who was all<n>over the headlines
during her classic<n>year...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The venue fills with warm, nostalgic<n>laughter, like
ripples over a pond. That<n>was a tough time in her
career, but<n>now it's remembered more as an
endearing anecdote in the legend<n>she's created.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
But no one can deny she was the<n>most successful
and talented dirt<n>runner last year. The polls speak
for<n>themselves!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone now acknowledges how<n>strong she truly
is, and I couldn't be<n>happier about it.
choice_data_list: (Even so, her mind is already made up.)

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy. Do you have any<n>thoughts to share
before you accept—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'mma stop ya right there!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Who said I was ready to acceptanything?

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-whaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Here's the thing... so listen up!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I don't need your silly award!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: WHAAAAAT?!

text_block_list.name: Viewers Drinking Tea
text_block_list.text: Pffft!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text:
This is crazy! Hey, get out your phone<n>and bring up
the URA stream!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text: Whasfkgjh?! W-Windy?!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
What're you talking about?! What do<n>you mean
you don't need the<n>award?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrrr! Everybody, just cool it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Now, I'mma only say this once!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...No award could ever measure up to<n>the legend of
Wicked Windy.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I mean... I'm the biggest, baddest,<n>and strongest
racer out there!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: But you all already knew that, right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So what's accepting an award gonna<n>do?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You'll be talking about me a hundred<n>years from
now, award or no award!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm totally fine<n>without—no, wait...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm actually happier without theaward! I want everyone's attentionon me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Attention isn't a prize to be given. It's<n>what
happens when eyes are<n>naturally drawn to the
same target.<n>That's the goal Windy has always
pursued.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, being in the spotlight<n>because someone
chose her for an<n>award...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
She's got a point! I mean, we've all<n>seen how
strong she is.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Is she trying to stir up trouble<n>again? But whoa,
the viewership is<n>skyrocketing!

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text:
She's nuts! Although, I kind of get<n>where she's
coming from...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So... Thanks, but no thanks!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You can keep your award!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Wait... Please, think this through!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh! Bet you weren't expecting<n>that!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I want all you out there, in the<n>audience and at
home, to remember<n>me as the big bad who kicked
an<n>award to the curb!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's all I've got to say!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer, time to split!

text_block_list.name: Invited Guest A
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
...Hahaha! Hahahaha! Sheesh... full of<n>surprises,
isn't she? She went and<n>did it again!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Well... um... that was certainly<n>unusual. But you all
heard what she<n>said!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
...This year, there won't be a recipient<n>for the
URA's Best Dirt Umamusume<n>award!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! That girl's too wild for<n>her own good.
What are you even<n>supposed to say to that?

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text: Windy...

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe! Ahahaha! Seriously, how<n>many surprises
do you have up your<n>sleeve?

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
Attention... huh. Everyone wants<n>attention,
especially when they're<n>kids. But usually, you
grow out of it.

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
You realize that you're no more<n>special than the
next person. Except...

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text: Windy's not like that.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I chase after Shinko Windy as fast as<n>my legs can
carry me. Before I know<n>it, my nervousness gives
way to<n>giddiness... and I start laughing like<n>there's
no tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Ahahahaha! Wheeew... Did<n>you see their
faces?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Pwfff! Yours is pretty funny, too! ♪
choice_data_list: You really went through with it!
You really went through with it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Sure did! That was the best prank<n>ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy is beside herself with<n>joy. It's a
strange thing the two of us<n>have just
accomplished.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Kehehehe... I still can't believe<n>it...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I really... managed to... pull it off!<n>Wicked Windy...
strikes again!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Hey... lackey.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Remember that time I really screwed<n>things up?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she's talking about the biting<n>incident, how could
I forget? That<n>event changed the trajectory of her
racing career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she brought it on herself, the<n>backlash was
unrelenting. I can't<n>imagine how much stress that
must've caused her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet she kept running, believing that<n>the controversy
would eventually<n>fade away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She refused to let the incident define<n>her career and
soldiered on!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's it, then... the big reset I've<n>been aimin' for.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's better than that, actually.<n>Everyone's payin'
attention to my<n>super strength!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wicked Windy's got the entirety of<n>Japan under
her thumb!
choice_data_list: Just wait until it starts spreading in the news.
Just wait until it starts spreading in the news.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! This is gonna go down as<n>one of the most
shocking events in<n>racing history!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: RAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes! I really did it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm the best! The most fearsome!<n>The biggest bad!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ahhh...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: It was so, so worth it!
choice_data_list: You really gave it your all.
You really gave it your all.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nah... that's my line. I bet it wasn't<n>easy keepin'
up with me.
choice_data_list: I kept going because it was you.
I kept going because it was you.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh? Ya callin' me a good boss?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Neeheehee! Good answer! ♪ And ya<n>better stick
'round, too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
'Cause I'm far from finished gaining<n>everyone's
attention.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
After all, if I wanna be immortalized,<n>this isn't
nearly enough race wins,<n>now is it?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heheeeh... ♪ Now, how should we<n>shock the world
next?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You got any ideas swimmin' in that<n>noggin of
yours?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: My next act's gotta be even bigger<n>than today's!
choice_data_list:
Then it's time for your diabolical strategist to take
the stage!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Knowing her... no matter what<n>mistakes she makes,
or what hurdles<n>she stumbles over, things will
always<n>turn out fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'll overcome anything and<n>everything, flipping
each narrative on<n>its head. Without a doubt, she'll
continue to build her one-of-a-kind<n>legend, one day
at a time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her ambition will become realitysomeday. And then, one hundredyears from now...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'll be remembered as the<n>strongest
Umamusume to ever step<n>out onto the track!
